# Read of unit U1, goal a-push-folds-a-records-only-move (round 1)

Subject: candidate diff /Users/wido/.metasystem/unit/20261109t155426-04f89ee31a/round-1/worktree.diff
(SHA-256 2bb01e8988c8d5041e542308cd1cfd93cb0c5d03f10ad540a17a8652b2395ab1; the prepared copy's
`git diff --full-index 3f9eec5f5d` has the same hash), judged against the build brief
/Users/wido/.metasystem/unit/.inputs/68ad4af2ad133d48579d23937d3755ec/build-brief.md.

## Verdict

AGREE. No material findings.

## What was checked

Checklist item 1, the diff against the brief:

- `GoalRecordPath` (internal/goal/goalmove.go) keeps every old acceptance and adds
  `records/goals/<id>.md` with no `/` in `<id>` (S1). Operator grouping is
  `register || (goals prefix && .md) || (records prefix && .md && one segment)`. Both doc
  comments updated. `GoalRecordsOnly`'s body is unchanged.
- `ConcludedIn(deleted, after)` (the function of item 2): true only for
  `plans/goals/<id>.md`, `<id>` non-empty and free of `/`, not the register, with
  `records/goals/<id>.md` in `after`, parsed with no problems and `Id == <id>`. It never
  reads the deleted page. `f` is dereferenced only after `len(problems) == 0`.
- `goalRecordsBetween` (internal/landing/plain/trunk_recovery.go): one
  `diff --name-status --no-renames FROM TO`; a line without a tab refuses; every path,
  deleted ones included, goes to `recordsOnlyPaths`; the empty, error and `filepath.Rel`
  refusals stay; the install-prefix and `GoalRecordPath` guards run before the status
  switch, for deleted paths too; A/M are read with `show TO:PATH`; D is kept unread; any
  other letter refuses (S3); every deletion must pass `ConcludedIn` against `after` (S5);
  then `GoalRecordsOnly(after)`. Only an added or changed record counts, so an
  unchanged record from before doesn't explain a deletion.
- Nothing else in production changed: `inheritFlakeRecords`, `inheritFold`, the reason
  strings, `recordsOnlyPaths`, `codeMoved` and the other `--name-only` callers are untouched.
- Tests T1-T6 are present as the brief describes. T1 "archive" wants true and the new
  "archive that does not parse" row is there. T2 has the four new rows. T3
  (`TestConcludedInRequiresTheSameGoalsRecord`) has all nine rows. The T4 fake answers
  name-status with D/A/M and keeps name-only. T5 has goal-done on the full accepted path,
  the three refusals and a design-deletion row for mutation (f). T6 has
  "a conclusion from main" on the goal-pages path and "an unexplained deletion" giving
  CodeUnproven. Every new subtest calls `t.Parallel()`.

Checklist item 2, the tests exercise the changed behaviour. I ran each brief mutation as a
`go test -overlay` on a copy, without editing the worktree. Each one turned the named
tests red:

- (a) `GoalRecordPath` without the archive rule: T1/archive, T2, T5 goal-done, T6 conclusion.
- (b) every deletion admitted: T3 (8 rows), T5 the three refusals, T6 unexplained deletion.
- (c) `Id` not compared: T3 another identity, T5 goal-done-record-names-another-goal.
- (d) any goal's record accepted: T3 another record and another identity, T5
  goal-done-with-another-record and goal-done-record-names-another-goal.
- (e) the deleted path read as today: T5 goal-done, T6 conclusion.
- (f) the `GoalRecordPath` guard skipped for D: T5 goal-done-beside-design-deletion
  ("read a goal page before refusing the deleted design").

Runs on the prepared copy, all green:

- `go test ./internal/goal -run '^(TestGoalRecordsOnly|TestGoalRecordPathNamesOnlyTheRegisterAndGoalPages|TestConcludedInRequiresTheSameGoalsRecord)$'`: ok
- `go test ./internal/landing/plain -count=1 -timeout 30m` (the whole package, so every
  other Git fake that answers `diff --name-only --no-renames` was exercised): ok, 69.9s
- `go test ./cmd/metasystem -run` on the landing flake, incident, fresh-full,
  reconciliation and deploy tests, the plans/ledger group test, and the live-ledger and
  messages audits: ok
- `gofmt -l` on the five files: clean. `go vet ./internal/goal ./internal/landing/plain`: ok.
  `go run ./cmd/devgate static`: fast checks passed.

## Non-gating observations

1. No test feeds the classifier a name-status line without a tab or a status letter other
   than A/M/D, such as T. Both refusals are correct by reading, but no test drives them. The
   brief's test list and mutation list do not ask for them.
   (trunk_recovery.go goalRecordsBetween)
2. The `deleted == trunkRedPath` clause in `ConcludedIn` can never fire, because
   trunkRedPath ends in `.json` and the `.md` cut refuses it first. The T3 "register" row
   is refused by the suffix check. This is harmless, and the brief asked for the clause.
3. Size: production changed 50 added / 8 removed lines, against the brief's estimate of
   about 40. Total is 171 / 22 (193), against about 190. Both are well under the
   250-line stop line. This is a signal for the steward, not a defect.
4. T6 now makes main's two commits in the order rehearsal first, first-run-fixes second,
   for every case, not only the two new ones. The existing assertions use only
   `folded[1]` and the full `folded` slice, and all cases pass.
5. The T4 fake's diff branch now answers only the 5-argument `--name-only` and
   `--name-status` forms with `--no-renames`. Before, it answered every 5-argument
   `diff`. The whole plain package is green, so no other form reached it.
6. `GoalRecordsOnly`'s doc comment still says "still present". That is true of `after`,
   but deletions are now settled by the caller before `GoalRecordsOnly` runs.

## Not checked within this read

- The whole `internal/goal` package. Only the three goalmove tests ran, and no other test in
  that package names `GoalRecordPath`, `GoalRecordsOnly` or `ConcludedIn`.
- The whole `cmd/metasystem` package. The coverage floors and Linux run need the full
  gate, which the lane runs.

VERDICT: land
